screens.name: FAQ / Payslip
texts: I can not see any payslips at all.
Make sure you have selected the correct employer above. Payslips show up here when your employer publishes them.
It can take up to 24 hours after publication for new payslips to appear. Pull down to refresh the list.
Older payslips may have been archived. Contact your payroll administrator to request access.
How do I download my payslips?
Open a payslip and tap the download icon in the top right to save it as PDF.
Use the checkboxes above to filter which companies you want to see payslips for.
Why do I not have access to Payslip?
Your employer must have activated the Payslip module for you. Contact your payroll administrator.
I can not find my employer in the list above.
Your employer might not have activated the app for you yet. Contact your payroll administrator.
The answer to my question is not here.
Use the Send feedback option below to reach the app team. For payroll questions, contact your payroll administrator.

screens.name: FAQ / Expense / first answer expanded
texts: I can not register a mileage.
Make sure your employer has enabled mileage registration. Some companies restrict this to specific user roles.
How can I see the status of a sent expense?
Open the Expense tab and switch to "Claims". The status is shown next to each claim.
Why do I not have access to Expense?
Your employer must enable the Expense module. Contact your payroll administrator.
I can not find my employer in the list above.
The employer must have activated Expense in the app. Contact your administrator.
The answer to my question is not here.
Send us feedback or contact your payroll administrator for content questions.

screens.name: FAQ / Time & Absence
texts: I can not report "Care of sick child".
This absence type must be enabled by your employer. Contact your payroll administrator if it is missing.
I got the message "Your user setup is incorrect".
Your user account in the payroll system is missing required configuration. Ask your administrator to verify your setup.
Why do I not have access to Time & Absence?
The Time & Absence module must be activated by your employer.
I can not find my employer in the list above.
Your employer must enable Time & Absence in the app for the company to appear here.
The answer to my question is not here.
Send us feedback or contact your payroll administrator.

screens.name: FAQ / Other
texts: You can report time or absence for
Where do I update personal information such as email or bank accounts?
Personal information is managed by your employer’s payroll system. Contact your payroll administrator to update it.
How can I add another employer to this app?
Your employer must activate Visma Employee app for you. Once activated, the company appears here automatically.
I can not find my employer in the list above.
The employer might not have activated the relevant module yet. Contact your administrator.
The answer to my question is not here.
Send feedback to the app team or contact your payroll administrator for content/access questions.
Avoid entering text with sensitive data.
Do not include personal identifiers, account numbers, or passwords in feedback. We can not handle sensitive data through this channel.

texts: Accessibility Statement for Visma Employee app
This is an accessibility statement from Visma Software AS for the Visma Employee app.
Visma Software AS takes the following measures to ensure accessibility of Visma Employee app:
Include accessibility as part of our mission statement.
Include accessibility throughout our internal policies.
Assign clear accessibility goals and responsibilities.
We welcome your feedback on the accessibility of Visma Employee app. Please use the Send feedback button below to let us know if you encounter accessibility barriers.
